warnings: op1 direct read (house 11). Steel ramp handrail: Ø1 1/2" top rail + Ø3/4" lower rail on Ø1 1/2" posts, 0.90m rail height — matches the accessibility grab-rail diameter convention from A-12 (also Ø1 1/2").

รูปตัด 2 is NOT part of the ramp itself — it's the เฉลียง (porch) floor-edge detail, grouped onto this sheet alongside the ramp sections since both are 'R.1'-adjacent details per the sheet title; recorded as printed.
